question: How many urban post offices are there in India in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15703**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of **2020**, the total number of **urban post offices in India **is **15,703**.
 
• These post offices serve **urban areas across the country**.
 
• They provide various postal services, **including mail delivery**, **parcel services**, and **financial transactions**.
 
• Urban post offices play a crucial role in facilitating **communication and commerce **in **cities and towns**.
 
• They are part of **India's extensive postal network**, which caters to the **diverse needs of the population**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Post Office:**

 
 
• One of the **world's largest postal networks**.
 
• Provides **mail, parcel, and financial **services across **India**.
 
• Established in **1854 **during **British rule**, continues to operate **post-independence**.
 
• Offers various services like **mail delivery, money transfer, and insurance**.
 
• Has rural and urban branches, total totalling **150,000 post offices**.
 
• Plays a crucial role in **communication, commerce, and financial inclusion**.
 
• Adapting to modernization with digital services while retaining traditional **mail functions**.
